$comment: One sentence per recipe key and part field, written by hand. crates/core_engine/src/character/recipe_schema.rs puts them into spec/character-recipe-1.schema.json and docs/character-recipe.md, and fails when a part or field has none. A field takes its part's sentence, else the `common` one.

top.$schema: The schema URL, for editors: https://sinua.dev/schema/character-recipe-1.json. Ignored by the engine.
top.$comment: A note for people. Ignored by the engine.
top.id: The character's name: 1–32 of a–z, 0–9 and -. An FX Spec file's `pattern` names it.
top.profile: The built-in character whose voice-state behaviour it borrows (how it turns, looks and moves per state). Without it, the shared `character` profile.
top.palette: The colours, by name: each `[hue 0–360, saturation 0–1, lightness 0–1]`. Parts name these; they are also the slots `palette` repaints. `celebrate` is reserved for the burst.
top.hue: `base`: the hue the palette is drawn at (the default `hue` option); `turns`: the colour names the `hue` option rotates.
top.contrast: `[[ink, ground], …]`: a face colour and the colour it sits on. A `palette` override that brings the ground too close lifts the ink.
top.rig: How the whole character moves: `pivot` (leans and squashes round a point), `upright` (stands on `base`) or `float` (drifts round `center`).
top.surfaces: Named spheres or cylinders (`c`, `r`, `depth`, `cylinder`) that face parts are drawn on, so they wrap round when the head turns. `face` is the usual one.
top.parts: What is drawn, back to front: up to 48 parts, a body's inner layers included.
top.burst: The celebrate burst: `at`, `r` and three `colors` (palette names), optionally a `space`.
top.slots: Named anchor points for cosmetics: `at`, and the chain it `follows` (`head`, `body` or `face`), with an optional `scale` and `angle` that size and turn a cosmetic for this character. `headTop`, `face`, `neck` and `chest` are the standard names cosmetics look for.
top.cosmetics: Cosmetics the character always wears (FX Spec 1.13): the same objects as an FX Spec file's `cosmetics`. A file's `cosmetics` come after these.
top.grain: `{ "strength": 0–1 }`: film grain inside every body (FX Spec 1.13, design note 22), a fine, still noise of light and dark specks; 0.08 is a good start. The `grain` option overrides it. Left out at 20 px and under low power; the face stays crisp.
top.roles: Which palette slot plays each role, `{ "primary": "<slot>", "secondary": "<slot>", "accent": "<slot>" }` (FX Spec 1.13): a named palette (`"palette": "sunset"`) or a brand colour (`{ "primary": "#E63946" }`) reaches the character through it. A role left out isn't repainted.

common.space: Where it moves: `body` (with the body and head), `face` (with the face, turned on its surface), `mount` (with a pivot rig's `mount`: between the stand and the body, as Hum's yoke), `ground` (stays on the floor) or `whole` (the character's box, unturned).
common.when: `notSmallOrAccessories`: left out at 20 px with `accessories` off. Absent: always drawn.
common.show: How visible it is per voice state, 0–1: `{ idle, listening, thinking, speaking }`; a state left out is 0. Absent: always, at its own alpha.
common.at: Where it sits: `[x, y]` in the 200-unit box.
common.x: The centre line it is mirrored round (x).
common.colors: Its colours (palette names), in the order listed below.
common.ink: The ink colour (a palette name); effects tint it.
common.outline.width: The outline width (scaled with the character's line weight).
common.segments: How many points a curve or ellipse is drawn with: 3–128.
common.surface: The surface it is drawn on (a `surfaces` name), so it wraps when the head turns. Absent: flat.
common.shape: A shape: `{ "ellipse": [cx, cy, rx, ry, rotation, segments] }`, `{ "roundRect": [x, y, w, h, radius, step] }` or `{ "path": "M… Z" }` (an SVG path with `M L H V C S Q T Z`; later subpaths are holes).
common.scale: Its size: `[at 64 and 32 px, at 20 px]`.
common.style: The eye style (design note 24): `shape` (the default, a solid shape), `glossy` (a lens, an iris and pupil that follow the gaze, highlights and a lid line), `pixel` (a grid of glowing cells; on a `faceScreen` the mouth too) or `dot` (a soft point). The `eyeStyle` option overrides it.
common.iris: The glossy eye's iris colour (a palette name). Absent: teal.
common.sclera: The glossy eye has a white sclera and a dark lid line instead of a dark lens.

shadow: The soft shadow under the character.
shadow.floats: Widens with the float rig's drift (a floating character's shadow breathes).

body: A shape filled with its light, its inner layers clipped to it, and an outline. `turnLight` `[dx, k]` moves a radial light as the body turns. `"light": "none"` (and no stops) draws only the layers: an overlay that adds soft layers over a part that has none (BUZZY's helmet).
body.light: `{ "radial": [cx, cy, r] }`, or an ellipse `[cx, cy, rx, ry, angle]` (radians; the centre stays put while the body turns under it), `{ "linear": [x0, y0, x1, y1] }`, or `"none"` (an overlay: no fill).
body.light.stops: The light's gradient: `[[offset 0–1, colour], …]`, each with an optional alpha `[offset, colour, alpha]`; any number of stops.
body.inner: Layers clipped to the body: `patch`, `band`, `stripes`, `glints`, `grille`, `shade`, `rim` or `eyes`.

eyes: The shared eyes: they blink, look round, follow the voice state and take the expression. A part on its own (in `face` space) or a body layer.
eyes.glow: A glow round the eyes, 0–1: one number, or `[at 64 and 32 px, at 20 px]`.

feet: Two feet of three strokes each, standing on the ground.
feet.x: The centre line between the feet.
feet.toe: A toe's reach `[dx, y]` from the foot.

crest: Curling feathers that lift while listening (higher with the user's voice), perk while speaking and droop while thinking.
crest.base: Where the feathers grow from `[x, y]`.
crest.spread: One number per feather: its sideways direction and spread (negative to the left).
crest.mid: Which feather (0-based) is the middle one; it rises highest.
crest.root: How far apart the roots are (times `spread`).
crest.ctrl: The curve's control point: `[x factor, y, lift factor, middle extra]`.
crest.tip: The tip: `[x factor, per-feather offset, y, lift factor, middle extra]`.
crest.lift.ears: How much listening lifts it: `[at rest, with the user's voice]`.
crest.lift.talk: How much speaking lifts it: `[at rest, with the level]`.
crest.turnShift: How far it slides sideways as the head turns.

wings: Two wings that flutter with the voice; turned, they swing round the body (the near one grows, the far one thins).
wings.at: A wing's centre `[dx from x, y]`.
wings.flutter.gain: The option name that scales the flutter (e.g. `flutterGain`).
wings.turn.near: How much the near wing grows when turned.
wings.turn.far: How much the far wing thins when turned.

beak: The beak is the mouth: its lower half opens with the voice.
beak.lower: The lower half's three points `[[x, y], …]`; the last one drops when it opens.
beak.drop: How far the lower tip drops, fully open.
beak.upper.quad: The upper half's curve: three points.
beak.upper.rise: How far the upper tip rises, fully open.
beak.open.effect: How open it is during success / celebrate.
beak.open.rest: How open it is at rest.

notes: Music notes rising while it speaks, and thought dots lighting in turn while it thinks.
notes.scale: A note's size: `[at 64 px, at 32 and 20 px]`.
notes.floor: The lowest note opacity while speaking.
notes.dots.r: A dot's radius `[first, growth per dot]`.
notes.dots.rate: How fast the lit dot moves along.
notes.dots.gain: How much brighter the lit dot is.

stand: A stand: a shadowed round foot and a stem.
stand.under: The shadow ellipse under the foot `[cx, cy, rx, ry]`.
stand.foot: The foot ellipse `[cx, cy, rx, ry]`.
stand.stem: The stem, a rounded rectangle `[x, y, w, h, radius, step]`.

yoke: A U-shaped yoke holding the body at its sides: a dark stroke under a lighter one.

tally: A tally light: red while listening, amber blinking while thinking, off otherwise.

halo: A soft halo: a radial fade (not drawn at 20 px).

spirit: A spirit's body: a round head flowing into a tail that curls (with `curlGain`), sways and trails the head turn, with smoke puffs off the tail tip and a shine.
spirit.head: The head `[x, y, radius]`.
spirit.tail.lag: How late the tail follows the head turn (seconds).
spirit.tail.swing: How far the tail swings with the turn.

ovalMouth: A mouth that is a small smile at rest, thinking dots, or an oval that opens with the voice; it takes the expression's resting mouth.

sparkles: Sparkles round the head: wandering at rest, gathering while listening, orbiting while thinking, streaming out with the voice.
sparkles.head: The point they move round `[x, y]`.

torso: A robot torso: a rounded shoulder shape lit top to bottom.

chestCore: A voice core on the chest: a dark disc, a ring and bars that move with the voice; it follows the head turn at 40 %.

earPods: Ear pods with chevrons and listening arcs; turned, they swing round the head.
earPods.front: This is the near pod's copy in front of the helmet (list it after the helmet).

helmet: A helmet: a rounded square lit from the top left; turned, its back edge shows.

fin: A fin on top of the helmet (64 and 32 px, with accessories).

faceScreen: A face screen: the eyes and mouth on it (clipped to it), its rim, and a glass visor with a drifting reflection; it rides the face surface.

steam: Soft wisps rising and fading: higher while listening, swaying more while thinking, thicker with the voice.
steam.at: Where the wisps rise from `[x, y]`.
steam.spread: How far apart the wisps start.
steam.rise: How high they rise (kept inside the box).

arms: Two arms (upper arm, forearm, hand): hanging at rest, a hand to the ear while listening and to the chin while thinking, beats while speaking. `arms: false` turns them off.
arms.shoulder: The right shoulder `[x, y]`; the left mirrors it round `mirror`.
arms.mirror: The centre line the arms mirror round (x).
arms.ear: Where the right hand goes while listening `[x, y]`.
arms.chin: Where the right hand goes while thinking `[x, y]`.
arms.back: This is the copy behind the body: the far arm, shown as the head turns away (list it before the body).

patch: A body layer: a shape in one colour, clipped to the body (on a surface, it wraps when the head turns).

band: A body layer: a shape in one colour clipped to the body, flat (a sleeve, a belt).

stripes: A body layer: thin rounded stripes across the body.
stripes.rect: A stripe: `[x, w, h, radius, step]`.

grille: A body layer and a mouth: slots that light with the voice while speaking and one light scanning while thinking.
grille.slot: A slot at 64 and 32 px: `[width, height, height when lit]`.
grille.smallSlot: A slot at 20 px: `[width, height, height when lit]`.
grille.rise: How it moves up `[at rest, when lit]`.

shade: A soft mass clipped to the body (FX Spec 1.13, design note 22): its own `light`, usually an ellipse whose stops fade to alpha 0, so it needs no blur. An airbrushed shadow or highlight, light bounced from below, a head's soft shadow on the body, or (on the `face` surface) a blush. Left out when `shading` is off and under low power.
shade.light: Its light: `{ "radial": [cx, cy, r] }` or `[cx, cy, rx, ry, angle]`, or `{ "linear": [x0, y0, x1, y1] }`. Draw the `shape` round the light's ellipse: outside it the light is transparent anyway, and a smaller shape paints less.
shade.light.stops: `[[offset, colour, alpha], …]`: fade the last stop to 0 for a soft edge.

rim: A rim of light along the edge the light reaches first (FX Spec 1.13, design note 22): the body minus itself moved by `offset`. Left out at 20 px, when `shading` is off and under low power.
rim.offset: `[dx, dy]`: the body moved away from the light; the rim is as wide as the move (`[6, 7]` lights the top-left edge).
rim.fade: How far (box units) it fades out against the offset, so it thins round the sides; 0 = even.

cosmetic: A cosmetic: `body` and `eyes` parts drawn on one of the character's slots, in the slot's local units (the slot point is (0, 0), up is −y; on `headTop` a hat has 40 units of height). It moves with the slot: the pose, the head turn, the hop.
cosmetic.id: Its name: 1–32 of a–z, 0–9 and -, unique in the list. Its colours are `<id>.<name>` in the palette, so `palette` repaints them.
cosmetic.label: What it is, for people ("party hat").
cosmetic.slot: The slot it sits on: `headTop`, `face`, `neck` or `chest` (or a slot a custom recipe names). A character without that slot doesn't wear it.
cosmetic.palette: Its own colours, by name, `[hue, saturation, lightness]`. Its parts name them; they hide the character's colour of the same name. Its parts may also name the character's colours.
cosmetic.parts: What it draws, back to front, on top of the character: `body` (with its layers) and `eyes`, without `space` or `surface`. Left out at 20 px unless `accessories` is on, or a part says `when`.
cosmetic.fits: The characters it is made for; any other doesn't wear it. Without it, every character with the slot wears it.
cosmetic.fit: Per character, a nudge: `at` (local units), `scale` and `angle` on top of the character's slot.
